incident-bot: RCA published for incident 'dedicated-autoscaler-race' — https://intranet.redwood/rca/1783456789
High-level: a race between the Dedicated autoscaler and the node health checker caused rapid provision/deprovision cycles for a subset of GPU pools, leading to degraded throughput and ~40% higher p95 latency for committed customers for ~2 hours. Root cause: health-check backoff was reset by a late heartbeat, combined with aggressive scale-down policy. Temporary mitigation: increased cooldown and paused scale-down for affected pools.

Elena: RCA is live. Please scan 'Mitigations' and 'Action items'. Owners called out: 1) autoscaler: add persistent backoff + leader reconciliation (Rohan) 2) node-health: make heartbeat idempotent and attach monotonic counter (Mei) 3) infra-ops: review pool-specific cooldown defaults and add pool-level sticky-mode (Carlos).

Rohan: Taking autoscaler changes. Plan: add persistent exponential backoff that survives process restarts (store in zk), and add periodic leader reconciliation every 5m. ETA next Tue. Any objections?

Mei: I'll update the health-checker to include a sequence counter in heartbeats and ignore out-of-order updates. Also adding a 30s graceful-fail window before marking node unhealthy. ETA Mon EOD.

Carlos: I'll create a migration to set affected pools to sticky-mode and increase default scale-down cooldown to 20m. Will coordinate with SRE on rollout. PR tomorrow.

Elena: Minimal repro we used in staging:
```
# reproduce rapid up/down by simulating flappy heartbeats
for i in {1..100}; do 
  curl -X POST https://staging-infra/heartbeat -d '{"node":"gpool-3","seq":'$i'}' && sleep 3 || sleep 1
done
```
This creates out-of-order heartbeats and simulates race conditions with scale decisions.

Rohan: Branch opened with backoff + reconciler: https://git.redwood/repo/789. Running integration tests now.

Mei: Health-checker PR: https://git.redwood/repo/790 — adds seq counter + 30s grace. Requesting review from @Carlos and @Rohan.

Carlos: Sticky-mode rollout PR: https://git.redwood/repo/791. Will gate by pool tag and only enable for 2 pools initially.

OpsBot: Scheduled follow-up checkpoint: Friday 10:00 UTC — will auto-invite owners.

Elena: Action tracker updated: https://kanban.redwood/board/rca-1783456789. Please attach PR links and ETA changes there.

Rohan: Early staging runs look good; reconciler prevents drift and backoff reduced oscillations in perf lab. Will run a 24h soak.

Mei: After health-check fix deployed to canary, no more out-of-order updates observed and the node flapping rate dropped to baseline.

Carlos: Monitoring: added a metric for 'scale-loop-count' per pool and alert if >3 loops in 15m. Dashboards updated.

Elena: Thanks all for the fast response. We'll close the incident channel but keep this thread as the source of truth for follow-ups. If you see any regressions, ping @Elena and @OpsBot to reopen. :white_check_mark:
